Name: Ace
Description: Successfully complete a Contract with 2 or more Hazard Dice targeting you.

Name: Barrage
Description: Play at least a total of 5 Damage on the same Contract (even if you fail it)..

Name: Chain Reaction
Description: Play at least 4 Reactor Cards toward a single Contract (even if you fail it).

Name: Daredevil
Description: Play no Green Shield cards when you've successfully completed a Green Rescue Contract..

Name: Efficiency
Description: Play no Yellow Thruster cards when you've successfully completed a Yellow Delivery Contract.

Name: Fire Support
Description: Play no Orange Damage cards when you've successfully completed an Orange Kill Contract.

Name: Generalist
Description: Have an Orange Magnomi, Green Henko, Blue Komek, and Yellow Ventus Ship Part simultaneously attached to your ship.

Name: Gun for Hire
Description: Successfully solo an Orange Kill Contract.

Name: Megaton
Description: Simultaneously have 3 Orange Magnomi Ship Parts attached to your ship.

Name: Money Bags
Description: Have 8 or more Credits at the very end of your turn (even if you failed the Contract)..

Name: Natural Leader
Description: Play at least 3 Crew Cards on the same Contract (even if you fail it).

Name: Over 9000
Description: Simultaneously have 3 or more Blue Komek Ship Parts attached to your ship.

Name: Quick Run
Description: Successfully solo a Yellow Delivery Contract.

Name: Quick Strike
Description: Play at least 3 Thruster cards on the same Contract.

Name: Saboteur
Description: Fail a Contract as an Ally (not a Mission Leader).

Name: Santa Maria
Description: Successfully solo a Blue Explore Contract.

Name: Shield Wall
Description: Play at least 3 Shield cards on the same Contract (even if you fail it)..

Name: Specialist
Description: Simultaneously have 2 or more Purple Sorelia Ship Parts attached to your ship.

Name: Speed Demon
Description: Simultaneously have 3 or more Yellow Ventus Ship Parts attached to your ship.

Name: Tank
Description: Simultaneously have 3 or more Green Henko Ship Parts attached to your ship.

Name: Tinker
Description: When you have 4 Ship parts attached to your Ship, replace one of them by purchasing a 5th Ship Part.

Name: Utopia
Description: Complete a Contract as a Mission Leader having every other player in the game participating in that Contract.

Name: You're My Hero
Description: Successfully solo a Green Rescue Contract.

Name: Arsenal
Description: Play 3 different types of Damage cards toward a single Contract (even if you fail it)..

Name: IO-Adopter
Description: Have 2 Crew and/or Ship Part cards with at least 1 IOsphere token on them.

Name: IO-Hoard
Description: Have a total of 6 IOsphere tokens on your Crew and/or Ship Part cards.

Name: IO-Power
Description: Spend 3 IOsphere tokens toward a single Contract (even if you fail it)..

Name: Junker
Description: Trash at least 2 cards toward a single Contract (even if you fail it)..

Name: Parasite
Description: Successfully complete a Contract without playing any cards.

Name: Tactical
Description: Play at least 2 Shield cards and 2 Damage cards on the same Contract (even if you fail it).

Name: Technologic
Description: Play 3 different types of Advanced Action cards toward the same Contract (even if you fail it).

Name: Untouchable
Description: Block 2 Hazard icons without playing a Shield on the same Contract (even if you fail it).

Name: Weird Flex
Description: Successfully solo a Flex Contract.

Name: Alliance
Description: Have 5 Faction Reputation with 1 Faction and 0 with all of the others.

Name: Backup
Description: Gain 4 or more Faction Reputation on the same Contract (even if you fail it)..

Name: Brute
Description: Fail a Contract as an Ally with a Mission Leader who either has the most Prestige or tied for the most Prestige.

Name: Call In Favors
Description: Spend 10 Faction Reputation toward a single Contract (even if you fail it).

Name: For Hire
Description: Spend Faction Reputation to get 2 Objectives when playing for the same Contract (even if you fail it)..

Name: Freeloader
Description: Join a Contract for no reward.

Name: Hoarder
Description: Have a total of 20 or more cards among your hand, draw pile, and discard pile.

Name: Invest
Description: Spend Faction Reputation to gain at least 3 Credits toward a single Contract (even if you fail it)..

Name: Manifold
Description: Spend Faction Reputation allowing you to draw 3 Cards on the same Contract (even if you fail it)..

Name: Responsive
Description: Spend Faction Reputation allowing you to gain 3 Actions on the same Contract (even if you fail it).

Name: Advantageous
Description: Trash a card during an Event.

Name: Clandestine
Description: Successfully solo a Contract on Sorelia.

Name: Harmony
Description: All players vote unanimously on a Policy.

Name: Opulence
Description: Simultaneously have 2 or more Purple Sorelia Prototype Ship Parts attached to your ship.

Name: Benefactor
Description: Take all of the Hazard Dice and none of the Credits on a Contract (even if you fail it).

Name: Blessing
Description: Roll at least 2 blank Hazard Dice during a Contract (even if you fail it).

Name: Glare of Space
Description: Roll 2 matching Hazard Dice toward a single Contract.

Name: Ms. Fortune
Description: Gain a Bonus Card that has a value of 4 or more Credits.

Name: Royale
Description: Gain a Bonus Card that has a value of 3 or more Credits.
